fact: The UN Economic Commission for Africa reports that a national validation workshop for the Tanzania Electronic Data Governance Strategy (TZeDGS) was held in Dodoma on 12 March 2026, and that the Ministry of Communication and Information Technology's director reaffirmed commitment to advancing it toward formal adoption, so it was not yet adopted.

Mwananchi reports that at a stakeholder meeting in Dar es Salaam in late August 2025 government, experts and the private sector discussed the roadmap for preparing Tanzania's National Data Management Framework, which was expected to be complete by January 2026, so it was still being prepared.
system: Mfumo wa Kitaifa wa Usimamizi wa Data (National Data Management Framework)
